title: East Maui Water Authority grant program funding
summary: The East Maui Water Authority grant program's funding doubled this year to $150,000, and staff said the next round will give out that amount. A $100,000 grant was announced in July, after a foundation committed $100,000 for early planning work. Earlier, the authority awarded $75,000 to five grantees, while requests topped $200,000.
